newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Q2 cocoa grind fell 4.1 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Q2 cocoa grind fell 4.1 pct on year.

text.p: The U.K. second quarter 1997 cocoa grind fell 4.1 percent to 42,702 tonnes when compared with the same period in 1996, the Biscuit, Cake, Chocolate and Confectionery Alliance (BCCCA) said on Friday.
The result compares with expectations the grind would be flat at best or a little lower in the quarter from the year before.
The second quarter grind fell by 3.1 percent from 44,059 tonnes in the first quarter of the year.
Earlier on Friday the Netherlands reported a higher-than-expected second quarter grind of 100,132 tonnes, up 10.4 percent from the same quarter of 1996.
In the first quarter of the year, the grind was up 1.46 percent to 102,338.
Cocoa grindings are considered a major indication of consumption.
